title: Abalyamu Abalonde olukwe
intro: Mu byafaayo byonna, ababaka ab’obwakatonda baatambuliranga mu bantu, era abamu ku baali kumpi nabo baalemererwa okutegeera ekitangaala. Ennyiriri zino zeetoolodde emyoyo ebiri okubeera okumpi n’obunnabbi bwe kyafuuka ekigezo kyabwe, era omusika gwabwe n’essomo eritaggwaawo.
clues: Twabeera mu biseera bya bannabbi abakulu, naye amaaso gaffe gaasigala nga gazibye ku mazima ge baaleeta.
Amaka gaffe gaali gajjudde okubikkulirwa okw’obwakatonda, naye emitima gyaffe gyakaluba.
Twafumbirwa abasajja abaalondebwa okulabula abantu baabwe.
Ekibonerezo bwe kyatuuka, tetwanoonya buddukiro mu lyato wadde okudduka enkuba eyaka, kubanga twasekerera okulabula.
Twogerwako mu Quran ng’ekyokulabirako eri abo abatakkiriza, ekiraga nti n’enkolagana ey’oku lusegere ne nabbi tewonya.
Ffe tuli bakyala ba Nuu ne Luti, abaabalyamu olukwe era bwe batyo ne basalirwa omusango.

trial.label: Okugezesebwa kwabwe kwali kutya?
options: Baali bafumbo ne bannabbi naye nga tebakkiriza
Baali bagumba era nga banenya bannabbi
Baali bagagga era nga ba maanyi
Bakemebwa Iblis okuva mu maka gaabwe
trial.answer: Baali bafumbo ne bannabbi naye nga tebakkiriza

arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍۢ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَـٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
verse: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter." (66:10)
